seed_derivation.test: SeedSequence([root_seed, i]).generate_state(1, dtype=uint32)[0] for i = 0 .. test_scenarios - 1; the scenarios that evaluate and benchmark derive from --seed root_seed --episodes test_scenarios
seed_derivation.calibration: SeedSequence(root_seed, spawn_key=(1, i)).generate_state(1, dtype=uint32)[0] for i = 0, 1, ... until calibration_scenarios seeds are chosen; a test seed or a seed already chosen is skipped (maintenance_arena.calibration.calibration_seeds)

tracks.name: core-continuous-v1
tracks.description: Core task of paper-core-continuous-v1: each scenario is one component from installation to its renewal, with the published continuous wear source and exact measurements. The oracle is the upper bound; the age, health and projection rules are calibrated on the calibration lives.

tracks.name: core-zero-deadline-v1
tracks.description: The scenarios and references of core-continuous-v1, but agents receive the observation with the deadline coordinate (index 3) set to zero, the Health + rate input set of the accompanying article. Health, wear rate and the validity flag determine that coordinate, so the information is unchanged; only the ready-made representation is removed.

tracks.name: gearbox-v1
tracks.description: Gearbox of paper-gearbox-v1 with operating choice (NORMAL, DERATE, REPLACE): each scenario is a 720-calendar-step window of the continuing task. The primary reference is exact dynamic programming (dp), the optimum of long-run average profit; the threshold rules keep the profile's settings.

tracks.name: resource-v1
tracks.description: Resource task of paper-resource-v1 with spare parts, one crew and shifts for three components: each scenario is a 720-hour window with an action mask. The primary reference is the 48-hour rolling-horizon planner; no oracle exists. The rules keep the profile's settings.

tracks.name: resource-lifetime-v1
tracks.description: Resource task with observed operating age of paper-resource-lifetime-v1: each scenario is a 720-hour window with an action mask. The primary reference is the 48-hour rolling-horizon planner; no oracle exists. The rules keep the profile's settings.
